Fighters Megamix Recomp

Fighters Megamix Recomp is a native PC port of Fighters Megamix for Windows, Linux, and macOS with high resolution and widescreen support.

README

Fighters Megamix Recomp

Join me on Discord

An unofficial native PC port of Fighters Megamix (Sega AM2, Sega Saturn, 1997) for macOS, Linux, SteamOS and Windows, made by static recompilation on satrecomp, the toolkit made for the Fighting Vipers port.

Early work. The game starts, its menus work and fights play to the end, all on the toolkit's own machine with no emulator. The opening movie plays and can be skipped. Nothing has been tested by hand yet.

No game files are included. You need a disc image you made from your own Fighters Megamix (USA) disc. No Saturn BIOS is needed.

The game's SH-2 code is translated ahead of time into C++ and compiled into the program, where it runs on satrecomp's own machine: its own video renderer, sound chip, CPUs and hardware, and its own stand-in for the BIOS. No emulator is part of the program. Megamix is built on Fighting Vipers' engine, and the routines the two games share (file loading, CD music, the controllers) are replaced by the same C++ in both.

The picture

  • High resolution: polygons drawn by your graphics card at the window's resolution, not the Saturn's.
  • Widescreen: 16:9, with more of the arena at the sides. It works in the fights seen so far; the other screens have not been checked in it.
  • The display your way: sharp, whole-pixel or smooth scaling, 4:3 or square pixels, the window's size, and RetroArch's CRT and scanline shaders.

More about the picture →

Everything else

  • Save states: nine slots, from the menu or F5 / F9 (keys).
  • Run-ahead: what you press seen a frame or two sooner, the game running exactly as without it (more).
  • Unlock everything: every character, course and extra option without playing for them, your own save kept as it is (more).
  • Controls: a gamepad or the keyboard for two players, every button changeable, and buttons pressed together on one key (more).
  • Updates in the launcher, and a portable mode that keeps everything beside the program (the launcher).
  • A training mode is planned, like Fighting Vipers' (docs/ROADMAP.md).

Installing

Download the file for your system from the releases page, then:

SystemFileThen
macOS 13 or later, Apple silicon or IntelFightersMegamix-macos.zipUnzip and open Fighters Megamix.app. It isn't notarized: the first time, right-click it and choose Open (or allow it under System Settings, Privacy & Security).
Linux x86_64, SteamOS (Steam Deck, Steam Machine)FightersMegamix-linux-x86_64.tar.gzUnpack and run fighters_megamix-launcher. On SteamOS, do this in Desktop Mode, and use the launcher's Add to Steam to have it in Game Mode.
Linux ARM64 (aarch64)FightersMegamix-linux-arm64.tar.gzUnpack and run fighters_megamix-launcher.
Windows 10 or later, x64FightersMegamix-windows-x64.zipUnzip and run fighters_megamix-launcher.exe. Windows warns about an unknown publisher the first time: choose More info, then Run anyway.

In the launcher, drop your disc image's .cue file on the window (or choose it), choose Features and Controllers as you like (or leave them), and Play. The launcher checks that the image is the release this port is made from (USA, MK-81073, V1.004) and remembers where it is; it never copies, moves or changes it.

The disc image must be one you made from a disc you own. This project can't help you find game files, and requests for them are closed. Where your settings and saves are kept: docs/LAUNCHER.md.

Controls

Keyboard: arrows, Z / X / C for guard, punch and kick, Return for Start; on a gamepad, the d-pad or left stick and the lower buttons. While playing, Esc, F1 or the gamepad's Back button opens the menu (its "Quit game" row is how you leave), and F11 switches full screen. docs/LAUNCHER.md has the whole layout and every key.

Status

The gameBoot, title, mode select, character select and arcade fights (rounds, replay, continue, game over) run; the opening movie plays to its end and can be skipped. Seen in screenshots taken with no window, not yet played, heard or watched in a window by a person.
PlatformsmacOS (Apple silicon, and Intel under Rosetta), Linux x86_64 (also a Steam Machine on SteamOS) and Windows x64 (under Wine): the release downloads replay a recorded fight to the same state as the Mac.

games/fighters_megamix/PROGRESS.md says what is native, what is known about the game, and what is still open; docs/ROADMAP.md has what is planned.

Building from source

See docs/BUILDING.md. In short, on a Mac with Xcode's command line tools, CMake, Ninja, Python 3 and SDL 3:

cp "/path/to/Fighters Megamix (USA)."* disc/     # your own disc image (.cue and its .bin files)
make && make record ARGS="--frames 6000"        # translate what the game runs
make app                                         # build/fighters_megamix/Fighters Megamix.app

docs/TOOLKIT.md explains how the port is made.

Feedback and contributing

Please open an issue for bugs, crashes, glitches or ideas, with your system, your controller and which features were on. CONTRIBUTING.md has the rules for code, the first of which is that nothing from the game ever goes in the repository.
